One who grows drowsy while praying should sleep until he knows what he is saying, lest he pray against himself instead of asking forgiveness.
Before the mosque was built, the Prophet prayed in sheepfolds.
Prayer was first enjoined as two rak'at at home and on journeys; the journey's prayer stayed so, while the resident's prayer was increased.
The Prophet prayed on mats, leading Anas, an orphan and an old woman on one, with Maimuna beside him in her menses and Aisha lying in front of him.
Ibn Umar prayed with his camel in front of him as a sutra, saying he had seen the Prophet do the same.
The Prophet prayed behind a spear as sutra at Eid and Al-Batha, passers going beyond it; his prayer place stood a sheep's width from the wall, and companions sought pillars.
The Prophet used his camel or saddle as sutra; one passing before a worshipper should be repulsed and sins gravely, and Aisha rejected likening women to dogs and donkeys.
The Prophet prayed with Aisha lying across before him, pushing her legs aside to prostrate and waking her for witr, with Maimuna beside him, and once carrying his granddaughter Umama.
Prayers wipe out evil deeds, even an unlawful kiss, as bathing five times a day removes dirt; timely prayer is the dearest deed, and Anas wept over prayer being lost.
Believers will see their Lord as they see the full moon, so they should not miss the prayers before sunrise and sunset, when the angels of night and day gather.
Believers will see their Lord as they see the full moon, so they should not miss the prayers before sunrise and sunset; whoever prays these two cool prayers enters Paradise.
When supper is served at the Iqama, eat first without hurrying; the Prophet stopped eating meat to pray without new ablution, and left his household work at prayer time.
On the day of the Trench the Prophet said the pagans had kept them from the middle prayer till sunset; the verse on guarding the prayers ended speaking in prayer.
Ibn Abbas said the verse on neither loud nor low prayer meant reciting so the pagans of Mecca would not hear and abuse the Quran; Aisha said it concerned invocations.
Called to prayer, the Prophet left his mutton and prayed without renewing ablution; when supper is served as the Isha iqama is called, supper comes first, as Ibn Umar did.
